disclaimer: Medsathi gives general information from public health guidance, not a diagnosis. It never replaces a doctor or pharmacist. For anyone pregnant, breastfeeding, under 12, elderly, or with a long-term illness, ask a professional before taking any medicine.

emergency.message: This can be an emergency. Go to a hospital or call 108 (ambulance) / 112 (emergency) right now. Do not wait for medicine.

conditions.advice: Rest, drink water/ORS often, wear light clothes, and sponge with lukewarm water if very hot.

medicines.name: Paracetamol 500 mg
medicines.why: Brings down fever and body ache
medicines.dose: 1 tablet after food, up to 3 times a day. Maximum 3 g in 24 hours.

conditions.seeDoctorIf: Fever above 39°C, lasting more than 3 days, with rash, stiff neck, fits, or in a baby under 3 months.

conditions.advice: Rest in a quiet dark room, drink water, eat on time, and limit screen time.

medicines.name: Paracetamol 500 mg
medicines.dose: 1 tablet up to 3 times a day after food.

medicines.name: Ibuprofen 200 mg
medicines.dose: 1 tablet after food, max 3 a day. Avoid if you have stomach ulcers or kidney problems.

conditions.seeDoctorIf: Sudden worst-ever headache, headache with fever and stiff neck, weakness in an arm or leg, slurred speech, or headache after a head injury.

conditions.advice: Steam inhalation, warm fluids, saline (salt water) nose drops, and rest. A cold usually settles in 5–7 days without antibiotics.

medicines.name: Cetirizine 10 mg
medicines.dose: 1 tablet at night. May cause drowsiness — do not drive.

medicines.name: Sodium chloride nasal drops 0.65%
medicines.dose: 2–3 drops in each nostril as needed.

conditions.seeDoctorIf: Symptoms last more than 10 days, high fever, ear pain, breathlessness, or noisy breathing.

conditions.advice: Warm water with honey (if over 1 year old), steam, and avoid smoke and cold drinks.

medicines.name: Dextromethorphan cough syrup
medicines.dose: As printed on the pack for your age. Not for children under 12.

medicines.name: Guaifenesin 100 mg/5 ml syrup
medicines.why: For a wet cough with phlegm
medicines.dose: As printed on the pack. Drink plenty of water.

conditions.seeDoctorIf: Cough for more than 3 weeks, blood in phlegm, chest pain, breathlessness, unexplained weight loss, or a cough in a child under 2 months.

conditions.condition: Sore throat · गले में खराश · Gala kharab
conditions.advice: Warm salt-water gargles 3–4 times a day, warm fluids, and rest your voice. Most sore throats are viral.

medicines.name: Paracetamol 500 mg
medicines.dose: 1 tablet up to 3 times a day.

medicines.name: Benzydamine lozenges
medicines.dose: 1 lozenge every 3 hours, max 6 a day.

conditions.seeDoctorIf: Difficulty swallowing or opening the mouth, drooling, one-sided severe swelling, or a rash with high fever.

conditions.advice: Eat smaller meals, avoid very spicy or fried food, do not lie down for 2 hours after eating, and raise the head of the bed.

medicines.name: Antacid (aluminium + magnesium hydroxide) suspension
medicines.dose: 10 ml after meals or when symptoms occur, up to 4 times a day.

medicines.name: Omeprazole 20 mg
medicines.dose: 1 capsule daily 30 minutes before breakfast, for up to 14 days. Ask a pharmacist first.

conditions.seeDoctorIf: Chest pain with sweating or breathlessness, difficulty swallowing, weight loss, vomiting blood, or black stools.

conditions.advice: Drink ORS after every loose motion — this is the most important step. Keep eating light food and avoid outside food.

medicines.name: ORS (oral rehydration salts)
medicines.why: Replaces the water and salts you lose
medicines.dose: 1 sachet in 1 litre of clean water. Sip after each motion. Discard after 24 hours.

medicines.name: Zinc 20 mg dispersible tablet
medicines.dose: 1 tablet daily for 14 days. For children as advised by a health worker.

conditions.seeDoctorIf: Blood or mucus in stool, high fever, vomiting everything, no urine for 8 hours, sunken eyes, or child looks very weak.

conditions.advice: Drink 2–3 litres of water, eat fruit and fibre (papaya, isabgol), walk daily, and do not strain.

medicines.name: Psyllium husk (isabgol)
medicines.dose: 1–2 teaspoons in warm water at night. Drink extra water.

conditions.seeDoctorIf: Blood in stool, severe abdominal pain, vomiting, or no motion with fever for more than a week.

conditions.condition: Body / muscle ache · बदन दर्द · Badan dard
conditions.advice: Rest, warm compress, gentle stretching, and enough water. Most body aches from viral illness settle in a few days.

medicines.name: Paracetamol 500 mg
medicines.dose: 1 tablet up to 3 times a day after food.

medicines.name: Diclofenac 1% gel
medicines.why: Local rub for a sore muscle
medicines.dose: Apply a thin layer 2–3 times a day. Do not use on broken skin.

conditions.seeDoctorIf: Pain for more than 2 weeks, swelling or redness of a joint, fever with severe muscle pain, or dark urine.

conditions.advice: Avoid the trigger (dust, a new soap, a food), keep the skin cool, and do not scratch.

medicines.name: Cetirizine 10 mg
medicines.why: Anti-allergy tablet for itching and hives
medicines.dose: 1 tablet at night. Causes drowsiness.

medicines.name: Calamine lotion
medicines.dose: Apply on affected skin 2–3 times a day.

conditions.seeDoctorIf: Swelling of the lips, tongue or throat, difficulty breathing, dizziness or fainting — this is anaphylaxis, treat as an emergency.

conditions.condition: Period pain · पीरियड दर्द · Period dard
conditions.advice: A hot water bag on the lower abdomen, gentle movement, and rest help most cramps.

medicines.name: Ibuprofen 200 mg
medicines.dose: 1 tablet after food, up to 3 times a day during pain. Avoid with stomach ulcers.

medicines.name: Paracetamol 500 mg
medicines.why: Alternative if ibuprofen upsets your stomach
medicines.dose: 1 tablet up to 3 times a day after food.

conditions.seeDoctorIf: Pain so severe it stops you working, very heavy bleeding, bleeding between periods, or pain with fever.

conditions.advice: Take small sips of ORS every 5–10 minutes, avoid oily food, and rest.

medicines.name: ORS (oral rehydration salts)
medicines.dose: Sip slowly and often. Same 1 litre recipe as for loose motions.

medicines.name: Ondansetron 4 mg
medicines.why: Only for moderate vomiting, ask a pharmacist
medicines.dose: As advised by a pharmacist or doctor.

conditions.seeDoctorIf: You cannot keep any fluid down, there is blood, severe abdominal pain, a headache with a stiff neck, or you are pregnant.

conditions.advice: Follow RICE — Rest, Ice for 15 minutes (wrapped in cloth), Compression bandage, Elevation.

medicines.name: Paracetamol 500 mg
medicines.dose: 1 tablet up to 3 times a day after food.

medicines.name: Diclofenac 1% gel
medicines.dose: Apply 2–3 times a day on intact skin only.

conditions.seeDoctorIf: You cannot put weight on the joint, the bone looks deformed, numbness, or no improvement after 3 days.

conditions.advice: Rinse with warm salt water, avoid very hot or cold food, and see a dentist — painkillers only hide the cause.

medicines.name: Paracetamol 500 mg
medicines.why: Temporary pain relief until you see a dentist
medicines.dose: 1 tablet up to 3 times a day after food.

medicines.name: Ibuprofen 200 mg
medicines.dose: 1 tablet after food, up to 3 times a day. Avoid with stomach ulcers.

conditions.seeDoctorIf: Facial swelling, fever, difficulty opening the mouth, or pain lasting more than 2 days.

conditions.advice: Cool under running tap water for 20 minutes, remove rings, cover loosely with cling film or a clean cloth. Do not apply ice, toothpaste or oil.

medicines.name: Paracetamol 500 mg
medicines.dose: 1 tablet up to 3 times a day after food.

medicines.name: Silver sulfadiazine cream
medicines.why: For small superficial burns, ask a pharmacist
medicines.dose: Apply a thin layer 1–2 times a day on clean skin.

conditions.seeDoctorIf: Burn larger than your palm, on the face, hands, feet or genitals, white or charred skin, or a child or elderly person.
